source.title: TNoodle 0.13.3
source.content:
TNoodle-WCA-0.13.3 is now available from https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles/
The following changes have been made since TNoodle 0.12.0:

 - TNoodle now supports connecting to the WCA website to retrieve the events and rounds of a competition.
 - FMC sheets are now available in 22 languages. The full list is available here: https://github.com/thewca/tnoodle/tree/v0.13.2/webscrambles/src/i18n.

This new release fixes a serious bug occurring in specific browsers with TNoodle 0.13.1, where the generated zip file would miss its extension.
It fixes another serious bug in TNoodle 0.13.2 and TNoodle 0.13.1 where the rounds ids were wrongly generated in the scrambles json file, making it impossible to use in the Workbook Assistant.

Appologies for any inconvenience these multiple TNoodle releases may have caused.

Please remember that official competitions must use a current version of the official scramble program. This is always available from:
https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles/

translation.title: TNoodle 0.13.3
translation.content:
TNoodle-WCA-0.13.3 现已可在 https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles/ 下载。
相比 TNoodle 0.12.0，有以下修改：

- TNoodle 现在支持连接 WCA 网站，获取比赛的项目和轮次。
- 最少步答题纸现提供 22 种语言版本。完整列表见：https://github.com/thewca/tnoodle/tree/v0.13.2/webscrambles/src/i18n.

此次发布修复了 TNoodle 0.13.1 在部分浏览器中的一个严重问题：生成的 zip 文件会缺少扩展名。
同时也修复了 TNoodle 0.13.2 和 TNoodle 0.13.1 的另一个严重问题：打乱 JSON 文件中的轮次 ID 生成错误，导致文件无法用于 Workbook Assistant。

对于 TNoodle 连续发布多个版本给大家带来的不便，我们表示歉意。

请记住，正式比赛必须使用现行版本的官方打乱程序。下载地址始终为：
https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles/
